hostname.description: Hostname for this node. Used in metric paths and remote connections.

fqdn_lookup.description: Whether to perform FQDN resolution for the hostname. Set false if DNS is unreliable.

basedir.description: Base directory for plugin data (e.g., RRD files, cache files).

pidfile.description: Path to PID file for the collectd daemon.

interval.description: Global data collection interval in seconds (minimum recommended: 10).

timeout.description: Default timeout (seconds) for plugin read/write operations.

plugins.description: List of plugins to load and their configurations.

config.description: Plugin-specific configuration keys and values. Nested dicts become <Subsection> blocks.

collectd_users.description: Authentication users for secure network communication (used with securitylevel 'sign' or 'encrypt').

secret_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the secret (hex-encoded). Safer alternative to 'secret'.

destinations.description: Remote servers to send metrics to (via network plugin client mode).

host.description: Hostname or IP address of remote collector.

port.description: Port to send metrics to (default for collectd is 25826).

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds (null = use global timeout).

network_listeners.description: Interfaces/ports to listen on when collectd acts as network server (network plugin).

encryption_file.description: Path to encryption key file (required if securitylevel != 'none').

auth_file.description: Path to authentication file (users.conf; required if securitylevel != 'none').

includes.description: List of additional config snippet files to include (e.g., /etc/collectd/conf.d/*.conf).

items.description: Absolute path to an include file.

plugin_logfile_file.description: Path to collectd log file (logfile plugin).
